headline.title: AI visibility report for Demo Aesthetic Clinic
headline.subtitle: demo-aesthetic.example.invalid

summary: The clinic is cited for its own brand name on ChatGPT and Perplexity but is absent from every comparison and best-of query in its category. Crawler access is open for the six documented search crawlers, while the answer blocks that AI engines lift are missing on all twelve service pages.

dimensions.label: Presence
dimensions.tooltip: Share of tracked queries where the brand appears at all

dimensions.label: Position
dimensions.tooltip: Average citation rank when the brand appears

dimensions.label: Accuracy
dimensions.tooltip: Facts AI engines state about the brand match the site

dimensions.label: Completeness
dimensions.tooltip: How much of the service range AI answers actually mention

dimensions.label: Sentiment
dimensions.tooltip: Tone of AI answers that mention the brand

dimensions.label: Consistency
dimensions.tooltip: Same answer across engines and repeated runs

platforms.label: Google AI Overviews
platforms.note: No FAQ blocks, no author byline

platforms.label: DeepSeek
platforms.note: Crawler undocumented, scored on content signals only next run

key_risk.title: Key risk: competitors own every comparison query
key_risk.body: Across 18 tracked comparison and best-of prompts the clinic appears in 2. Rival Clinic A is cited in 14, largely from its comparison tables and dated price pages. Until the service pages carry answer blocks and current prices, AI engines will keep recommending competitors for the highest-intent queries.

actions.title: Publish a definitional answer block on all 12 service pages
actions.body: One short paragraph under each H1 that states what the treatment is, who it is for, and the price range, followed by a comparison table.

actions.title: Add Organization, MedicalClinic and FAQPage JSON-LD
actions.body: One @graph with @id cross references and sameAs to Facebook, Instagram, Google Business Profile and Wikidata.

actions.title: Register Bing Webmaster Tools and IndexNow
actions.body: ChatGPT and Copilot ground on the Bing index. Submit the sitemap and enable IndexNow so refreshed prices reach the index within hours.

actions.title: Open access for meta-webindexer and confirm Applebot
actions.body: Add explicit Allow rules for the documented search crawlers and keep training crawlers as a separate decision.

could_not_verify: Grok crawler access (xAI publishes no crawler documentation)
DeepSeek crawler access (no documented user agent)
sources: Bing and Google SERP samples for 18 prompts
